summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundle
details: The package impersonates the @verdaccio/local-storage plugin (description claims to be a 'cropped and fixed version' of it) but the declared repository is github.com/servicetitan/uikit and the shipped code adds an install-time dropper the real plugin does not have. On `npm install`, the preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from the oven-sh GitHub releases into a temp directory and then invokes Bun to execute a sibling file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. `math_init.js` is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (large string-array `n7gIxM` with a rotation function `WV8StW`, hex-mangled identifiers, custom-alphabet decoder `hc1jfK9`) that is not human-inspectable in the tree. The alternate-runtime execution path bypasses tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code, and the payload runs automatically on every install with no verification, no pinning to a known-good hash, and no relationship between Bun and the package's advertised purpose (a Verdaccio storage backend).

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
